title: Keep a positive cooperative exit channel separate from a proved lifetime
statement: For two original units with V=lambda M_A M_B,0<|lambda|<1/2,the source computes a positive simultaneous lower/upper photon on-shell coefficient despite both local parities being conserved. It formally gives Gamma=8pi lambda^2 g^4 J(lambda)+o(g^4),J(0)=16/(27pi^2).

requires: Two active modules in fixed local two-excitation sectors
Actual density coupling and ordered weak-coupling expansion
provides: Source-reported explicit ordinary coupling that removes time-ordering cancellation
Shows why a local sector gap alone is not a composition guarantee
assumptions: No fourth-order resonance theorem or finite-time remainder is supplied
Outgoing residual memories can subsequently radiate; not permanently bound remnants
Population Gamma is twice amplitude linewidth
costs: Physical density coupler,total interaction budget and control schedule
No archived Fock/convolution program or numeric JSON acquired
contract.units: hbar=B=1,source-local energy/time and stated amplitude versus population conventions; no automatic device-unit conversion
contract.obstruction: A formal positive on-shell coefficient is not a measured decay law.

evidence.range_scope: Original cooperative spectrum,ordered emission amplitude and source-reported coefficient with explicit missing resonance theorem.

body: Source-reported positive on-shell transition coefficient. A fourth-order resonance theorem and finite-time remainder are not supplied; no measured decay is inferred.
